profile.summary: Aim High is a nonprofit that runs a free, multi-year summer enrichment program for middle school students in grades 5-8 across Northern California. It was founded in San Francisco in 1986 and also trains aspiring teachers through the program. The organization says its goal is to increase educational equity.
